title: What happens if you shift into Reverse while driving?
hook: Stop trying to shift into Reverse now.

script.narration: Stop trying to shift into Reverse now. Most modern cars have a built-in safety lockout mechanism.
script.visual_search: driver hand shifting gear lever close up

script.narration: If you are moving forward and push the lever into Reverse, the transmission computer simply ignores the command.
It won't grind the gears or explode the transmission. It just stays in drive until you slow down safely.
Like if this helped, follow for daily driving tips. Have you ever accidentally moved the shifter while driving? Tell me below.

description: Ever wondered what happens if you accidentally shift into reverse while driving? Modern safety technology prevents damage, but it is important to understand how these systems work. Learn the truth about transmission safety in this quick tip.
why_it_will_work: This taps into the popular 'What happens if' curiosity format which performs well for my channel, focusing on common driver fears regarding car mechanics.
